criteria.requirement: Extend real PMap.update/update_with input adaptation from mapping-only .items() to mappings OR single-pass (key,value) iterables. Preserve multi-source left-to-right order, duplicate-pair last-write or update_fn fold semantics, persistent original ownership and CheckedPMap evolver checks. Consume generators once, propagate malformed pair/source/callback/type failures and never return a partially updated original. Keep pmap constructor and existing union API unchanged because they already support their documented roles; this goal specifically implements missing update input capability.

Investigate the real source, explain the call path and clarify the business requirements before obtaining plan approval and implementing. Deliver real engineering changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. Repair independently reported failures; questions, answers and documentation do not count as separate completed objectives.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual business behavior and the frozen scope; do not grade by matching the reference patch text.
